title: WHERE Clause
description: Filter rows using WHERE, pattern matching, and NULL checks.

data.text: The WHERE clause filters rows. Use it with equality, comparison, and pattern-matching operators.

data.title: Filter Rows
data.code:
SELECT id, email
FROM users
WHERE country = $1
  AND created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND email ILIKE '%gmail.com'
LIMIT 100;

data.title: ILIKE
data.text: PostgreSQL supports ILIKE for case-insensitive pattern matching.

data.title: Exercise: Filter Active Users
